name: pablom-plugins
description: Plugins for UX research and testing by Pablo Manzoni (Kaizen Softworks).

plugins.name: user-simulation
plugins.description: Synthetic UX testing over a live web app with one command: "user simulation" + a URL, 3 quick questions, and a one-page action summary. Simulates inferred or custom users and/or runs an expert Nielsen heuristic review. No setup required.
